# Object

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Terminology](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Object)*

An object is a nonliving, distinct thing. Composite things, like buildings, comprise more than one object. *See also* "[Breaking Objects](../Exploration/Breaking-Objects.md)."
